sloka: तव शुश्रूषणम् मूर्ध्ना करिष्यामि वने वसन् ।अयोध्याम् देव लोकम् वा सर्वथा प्रजहाम्य् अहम् ॥२-५२-५४॥
transliteration: tava śuśrūṣaṇam mūrdhnā kariṣyāmi vane vasan ।ayodhyām deva lokam vā sarvathā prajahāmy aham ॥2-52-54॥

translations.english: As I dwell in the forest, I shall serve you with my head bowed. For this I may altogether relinquish Ayodhya or even heaven.
